hook.say: True or false? Five capital city traps. Three seconds each, and the last one sounds made up!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Toronto is the capital of Canada.
questions.fact: The capital is Ottawa. Toronto is just the biggest city.
questions.sayAnswer: False! The capital is Ottawa. Toronto is just the biggest city.

questions.q: Wellington is the capital of New Zealand.
questions.fact: Wellington is the capital. Auckland is the largest city.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Wellington is the capital. Auckland is only the largest city.

questions.q: Rio de Janeiro is the capital of Brazil.
questions.fact: Brasília replaced Rio as the capital in 1960.
questions.sayAnswer: False! Brasilia replaced Rio as the capital back in 1960.

questions.q: South Africa has three capital cities.
questions.fact: Pretoria, Cape Town and Bloemfontein share the job.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Pretoria, Cape Town and Bloemfontein share the job.

questions.q: Nauru has no official capital city.
questions.fact: The tiny Pacific island nation has no cities. Yaren is only the de facto capital.
questions.sayAnswer: True! The tiny Pacific nation has no cities. Its government simply sits in the Yaren district.
